title: The $400K Childcare Hoax
description:
The View cooked a study to tell you kids cost $400K a year. They took the most expensive child care option available, applied a poverty formula to every American family, and called it journalism. Meanwhile lower income single earner households are the only Americans reproducing above replacement rate. People with children report better mental health, better relationships, and more fulfillment. The data destroyed their argument.
